title: SourceCreate
description: API-key Source creation input. It extends the unsaved observation request with display and reconciliation data; the server still owns Source identity, protocol evidence, discovered inventory, health, usage, custody metadata, and timestamps. When client_nonce is present, the server claims it before observation or credential work.

vendor.description: Vendor id used by the response-backed observation.

display_name.description: Optional user-facing name. Omission uses the server's canonical vendor label.

base_url.description: null selects the vendor's official endpoint; a custom value selects a relay or self-hosted endpoint.

key.description: Transient plaintext credential. It is never returned or persisted in Source state.

protocol_order.description: Optional one-time probe order containing every protocol exactly once. It orders observation and never supplies a protocol conclusion.

client_nonce.description: Optional client-generated create correlation held before submission. The server atomically claims it before observation or credential work, persists it unchanged on the resulting Source, and rejects an already claimed or committed value before repeating that work. GET /api/models/sources can therefore reconcile a lost create response.
